jobs.page: 01_Survival/Moon 2 Day 27 - A Fastening That Holds the Heel.md
jobs.scene: Short dry repeat fit trial on the small rise, with low diagonal heel retention on the existing bast soles.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: opening illustration for the Humanity Handbook Obsidian narrative. Create ONE new wide landscape 16:9 illustration, no text or panels.
Input images: Image 1 is the original protagonist IDENTITY and daily illustration STYLE reference only; do not copy its clothing state or exact pose. Image 2 is the dated CLOTHING reference only; do not copy its character-sheet layout, labels or multiple figures.
Identity and medium: the SAME lean adult man, about thirty, dark wavy ear-length hair, short dark beard, natural smooth skin; fine brown ink and watercolour, warm earth palette and pale paper edges, realistic modest material scale, restrained detail like Image 1.
Mandatory current clothing: plain LOW grey-brown rabbit-fur crown pad with folded margin and loose forehead/back retention, face and ears exposed, NO rabbit head, face, long ears, tail or chin strap. ONE narrow rust fox strip on his anatomical LEFT shoulder (viewer RIGHT in a frontal view). TWO separate golden-grass hanging screens, one front and one back, with upper headers and two light retaining rows, hip-length, loose open sides, bare arms. Where visible show the rear screen's edge behind the flank, not a third screen. Under these, existing brown bark waist panels and small pale rabbit pelvic pad. BOTH feet wear thin flat interlaced willow-bast soles with corded margins, sparse dry-grass lining, low forefoot ties and low heel retention, open toes and exposed ankles; no boots, moccasins or modern sandals.
Anatomy: one figure, exactly two legs and two natural hands, no doubled limbs, skin not crosshatched as wounds. The cap and garments are handmade and coarse, not an animal mask or armour. No invented equipment, labelled diagrams, writing, watermark, modern objects or new people.
Scene: Moon 2 Day 27, cool dry daylight on the small dry rise directly beside the woodland terrace camp in the familiar limestone autumn valley. A quiet moment in a footwear fit trial. He stands in a natural modest stepping stance, near-frontal torso turned slightly toward viewer left, glancing down at his feet. Full body and both footbeds clearly visible, one foot on the very small gentle rise and the other lower, without an acrobatic pose. Arms rest naturally. His anatomical LEFT fox strip is on viewer RIGHT.
Technology focus: same flexible shallow bast footbeds, not thicker shoes. Each heel is retained by a LOW sling behind the heel, whose two ends run DIAGONALLY down and forward to separate rear-quarter points at the sole margin. No tight circumferential ankle ring, no high cuff; the changed route is simple, not a dense harness. Show a small amount of slack rather than constriction.
Composition: traveller slightly right of centre, readable footwear in foreground; subdued low debris shelter with its covered return extension far left and soft valley distance. Minimal props, no food inventory. Nothing is being hunted or fired. No dramatic mountain climb or suggestion of improved tread.
